segments.t: But I say that so long as the heir is a child,
he is no different from a bondservant,
segments.note: 主語の「he is」は英語の補い

segments.t: though he is lord of all,
but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
segments.note: τὴν προθεσμίαν τοῦ πατρός を「the day appointed by the father」とほぐす

segments.t: So we also, when we were children,
were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
segments.note: δεδουλωμένοι を「were held in bondage」とほぐす。στοιχεῖα は「elemental principles」

segments.t: But when the fullness of the time came,
God sent out his Son,
born to a woman,
born under the law,
that he might redeem those who were under the law,
that we might receive the adoption as children.
segments.note: υἱοθεσίαν を「the adoption as children」とほぐす

segments.t: And because you are children,
segments.note: ὅτι を「because」と訳す

segments.t: God sent out the Spirit of his Son
into your hearts,
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は ἡμῶν（私たちの）だが WEB は「your」と訳す（異本系）

segments.t: crying, “Abba, Father!”
So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son;
and if a son, then an heir
of God through Christ.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文（κληρονόμος θεοῦ διὰ Χριστοῦ）に従い「of God through Christ」とする。ギリシャ語本文は κληρονόμος διὰ θεοῦ

segments.t: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage
segments.note: μὲν（3番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: to those who by nature are not gods.
But now that you have come to know God,
or rather to be known by God,
why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles,
to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
segments.note: πάλιν ἄνωθεν を「all over again」と訳す

segments.t: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
segments.note: 主語の「You」はギリシャ語動詞に含まれる

segments.t: I am afraid for you,
that I might have wasted my labor for you.
segments.note: 「my labor」は κεκοπίακα のほぐし

segments.t: I beg you, brothers,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（δέομαι ὑμῶν が文末→文頭へ）

segments.t: become as I am,
for I also have become as you are.
You did me no wrong,
but you know that
because of weakness in the flesh
I preached the Good News to you the first time.
segments.note: 「the Good News」は εὐηγγελισάμην に含まれる目的語

segments.t: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh,
segments.note: 文頭の καὶ（1番）は英語に現れないので対応なし

segments.t: you didn’t despise nor reject;
but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
What was the blessing you enjoyed?
segments.note: μακαρισμὸς を「the blessing you enjoyed」とほぐす

segments.t: For I testify to you that,
if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
segments.note: 「them」は英語の補い

segments.t: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
They zealously seek you in no good way.
No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
segments.note: 「little」は英語の補い

segments.t: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
segments.note: τὴν φωνήν μου を「my tone」と訳す

segments.t: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh,
segments.note: 「the son」は ὁ のほぐし

segments.t: but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants.
One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
segments.note: γεννῶσα εἰς δουλείαν を「bearing children to bondage」とほぐす

segments.t: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia,
and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
segments.note: συστοιχεῖ を「answers to」と訳す

segments.t: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
segments.note: 「all」は英語の補い

segments.t: For it is written,
“Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear.
Break out and shout, you who don’t travail.
For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”
segments.note: 語順の組み替え。「women」は英語の補い

segments.t: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は ὑμεῖς（あなたがた）だが WEB は「we」と訳す（異本 ἡμεῖς 系）

segments.t: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
segments.note: 二つ目の「was born」は英語の補い（τὸν κατὰ πνεῦμα のほぐし）

segments.t: However, what does the Scripture say?
“Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
